title: Cylinder amplitudes and logarithmic bridge-length windows on the honeycomb lattice
main_claim: Summed over integer heights H ≤ 2h(log h)^{1/64}, critical honeycomb strict bridges with center length in [h^{4/3}(log h)^{-1/8}, 2h^{4/3}(log h)^{1/2}] have total mass ≥ c h^{3/4}(log h)^{-C}. Supporting results: B_H ≍ H^{-1/4}, A_g ≍ g^{-5/4}, a strip diameter tail, and the polygon second moment ≤ C R^{2/3}(1+log log R).

issues.location: Sections 2-7 (eq. L:eq1, F(1^m;1^m;2) ≍ m^{1/6}) and Section 5 (cylinder height/pressure tail)
issues.description: The analytic inputs are too compressed to check line by line: the constant-factor cylinder gas estimate eq1 (via oscillator traces, the change of expansion, and nonvanishing of the leading coefficients) and the exponential cylinder height tail. The window proof needs both: eq1 for the strip gas lower bound h^{1/12}(log h)^{-1/12}, and the height tail for the aspect cutoff and for dropping tall separators. I did not find a specific failing step. The exponent bookkeeping 3/8 - 5/24 = 1/6 is consistent.
issues.evidence: 07.tex final paragraph of the eq1 proof ('Dividing now gives eq1') rests on a long seam/particle localization argument with only sketched error bounds.

coverage:
I checked Sections 10-11 (the geometric assembly) in detail and read the Section 7 plane version and visit comparison eq6. I did not verify the analytic Sections 2-6, 8 and 9 line by line. Checks:
- Retained first moment: c h^{13/12}(log h)^{-1/12}, from the cylinder at period h/(C1 log h), dropping tall separators, and a symmetric split giving Z_strip ≥ sqrt(F).
- Three-chunk Hölder on diameter bins: h^{13/12}(t/h)^{5/3} e^{-ct/3h}, which is superlogarithmically small when s/h = (log h)^{1/128}.
- Loss exponents: (log h)^{-59/256} for length > ℓ+, (log h)^{-1/8} for length < ℓ-, and (log h)^{1/384-3/4} for small gaps. Each is o((log h)^{-1/12}).
- Retained mass h^{-1/4}(log h)^{-7/12}.
- Geometric moments: Hölder exponents k = 2/(2-p) and 4/(2-p) (integers for p = 1, 3/2) give g^{p-1/4} and s^{1/2+4p/3}. The fixed-cut moment g^{-2+r/2} and the 3/2-moment conversion (t/h)^{5/2}h^{7/4} both check.
- Double-cut binomial moment: the exponential weighting gives e^{C1 k}(C√(R/k))^{k-1}, and the tail CR^{5/2}√k(C√k/log R)^k is superpolynomially small for k ~ c(log R)^2.
- Recovery multiplicity is C·M.
- Connector geometry: normal angles -π/2, -π/6, -5π/6, pairwise dot products 1/2, slope 1/2 of the u-ray, remaining distance δD/2 to δD. The scale ratios S/r stay polylogarithmic.
- Connector lengths are at most h^{4/3}(log h)^{1/48} < ℓ+.
- Final count R0 · h^{-1/4} = h^{3/4}·polylog.
- Aspect cutoff: gap-interval swap argument, suffix cost √D, k-th root limit, and clipping to a single height.
- Caps and gap comparison: coefficients cos(7π/16), -sin(π/8) vs sin(π/4), and the slant tangent angles.
- Arch upper bound g^{-5/4}, box length moment r^{25/12}, and the growth length cutoff (C/M) r^{3/4}.
sibling_notes: This is consistent with the family 237 sibling reports. The 13/12 first-moment exponent, the 4/3 length scale and the R^{2/3} polygon second moment match the companions (Uniform-marked-polygon, Cylinder-loop-weights).
